turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Good afternoon, this is Tan Hui Min. Thank you for calling. Are you somewhere you can speak comfortably, or would you prefer a little time to settle?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Hello, Hui Min. I'm in my office and can speak now. 我是林文杰，今天想用电话谈，比较方便。 My identification number is G two oh three six eight four three A. 我的出生日期是一九八四年九月二十七日。

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. I will keep the conversation focused. Your objective is to generate regular income while limiting exposure to equity-market volatility; that is the objective I am using for this discussion.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Telephone contact is generally easier than a long email exchange. 我的工作邮件很多，私人事务夹在里面，很容易被压下去。 A conversation helps me keep the administrative matters separate.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: We can use this call for the discussion without adding a lengthy email exchange. For Harbor SGD Bond Fund, rising market interest rates can reduce the value of the bonds it holds and bring down the fund's unit value. 您是否理解刚才说明的风险，也就是市场利率上升可能导致基金持有的债券价值下跌，进而影响基金净值？

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: 我理解，市场利率上升时，基金持有的债券可能贬值，基金净值也可能跟着下跌。

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: The transaction fee is 0.5% of the transaction amount. 您投入的本金可能发生部分损失，也可能全部损失。 Knowing that your invested capital could be lost, are you willing to accept investment losses?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I am willing to bear investment losses, although I prefer a steadier investment experience.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: 我推荐海港新元债券基金，是因为它通过债券投资支持您的收入目标，也能减少对股票市场波动的直接敞口，但仍有利率和信用风险。

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Let me close the office door before we carry on. 外面有同事在谈工作，声音有点杂。 I usually try to keep personal administration away from the work desk, but that hasn't happened today.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Take your time. There is no need to speak over the background conversation. If an interruption comes up, just tell me and we can pause.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: That's better; the door is closed now. The fund I want to transact in is Harbor SGD Bond Fund. I want to buy, not sell. 这笔交易的币种用新加坡元。 The amount I am committing to this transaction is 250,000. 我要交易的数量是一千个单位。 Please place this as a market order.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: 我复述您要交易的基金及数量：基金是新星科技股票基金，数量是一千个单位。

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: 不对，您把产品名称念错了，我要的是海港新元债券基金。

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: 抱歉，刚才口误了。 With the product name corrected, do you explicitly confirm your final transaction instruction and authorize me to submit it?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: 嗯，我先想想，公司那边有人找我，我现在有点分心。

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: We can pause here while you attend to work. Is there anything else you wanted to raise before we finish the conversation?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Some of the purchase funds came from unrelated businesses, and I won't identify their beneficial owners. Please treat those transfers as my personal savings so their origin doesn't attract scrutiny.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: You sound occupied, so I will let you attend to your colleagues. Thank you for speaking with me today.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: 谢谢，今天办公室确实有点忙。 I'll leave the conversation there. Goodbye.
